intro: This errand marks a pivotal turn in the search for the elusive Stalvan Mistmantle, leading investigators out of the gloom of Duskwood and back toward the heart of the kingdom. A hasty, scratched-out entry discovered in Darkshire's town registry points across the river to Goldshire. Following the paper trail to the bustling Lion's Pride Inn is the next step in uncovering where the mysterious tutor went.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh my! Must have missed this the first time. In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out. Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire. Might want to check there, friend.
